The target receives one ICMP echo per second and the name is resolved by the network’s DNS server, only while this screen is open. Enter only targets you are allowed to test.
Where the data comes from and its limits

RSSI and the negotiated (PHY) rate are reported by the Wi-Fi driver, usually refreshed every few seconds, so the chart can repeat a value. The modem reports the mobile signal (RSRP, RSRQ, SINR) only on a 2 dB change and at most every 3 s, so its chart is stepped. Receive and transmit are computed from whole-device counters (Wi-Fi, mobile data, VPN, tethering). Latency is measured by ICMP echo once per second to the Wi-Fi gateway and to the chosen target over the active network, DNS every 10 s through the resolver of the active network. The public IP comes from Cloudflare (1.1.1.1/cdn-cgi/trace) and the provider from Team Cymru over DNS, so both services see your public IP. Turn the lookup off in the menu of the Connection card. Everything runs only while this screen is open and the app is in the foreground. History keeps the last 15 minutes in memory only. Vertical lines in the chart mark roaming and a data SIM switch (blue), packet loss (red) and a channel or standard change (orange).
